chapter: Moving to California and the war years
title: The group breaks up and the draft board turns him away
summary: The Spirits broke up out west, and the Army gave him an induction physical but never inducted him.

blocks.x: Yeah. So the group kind of broke up.
Yeah. We broke up out here.
It was just a couple of years, then, '41, '42, something like that?
Of course they weren't making any records then, were they?
You didn't go in the service?
Uh-uh. They had me -- you know, had me sell all my clothes and get ready for it, but they never called
You mean you got a notice but -- the first warning.
And I went down and appeared when I was supposed to be there, to appear. And I got -- what did you call it?
I got an induction, but they didn't induct me.
Oh. They gave you a physical, maybe.
Huh. At that time, at least in New York -- you're talking about 1942?
